title: 龙泰资管郝洪：成长股与价值股分化达极端，预计未来两个月将出现板块轮动
speaker: How Home

segments.en: Yeah, well I think the Chinese names are getting comparable valuation from the US and some of them are actually trading at a much higher multiples.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为中国公司估值与美国同行相当，有些甚至估值倍数更高。

segments.en: And yet today performance is actually beating the US peers. All right, so I think at this stage we're actually seeing the relative performance of the growth stocks, the tech hardware stocks, and the semi-names, substantially outperform the traditional value names.
segments.zh: 而且当前表现实际上超过了美国同行。所以现阶段，成长股、科技硬件股和半导体股的表现大幅优于传统价值股。

segments.en: The outperformance has reached a very sort of an extreme that we haven't seen in the past history. Only once, that was in early 2021.
segments.zh: 这种超额表现已达到历史罕见的极端水平，仅在2021年初出现过一次。

segments.en: And after such strong relative performance, there tend to be a sector rotation going on. All right, so we're expecting a sector rotation towards the traditional value sector, probably in the next two months or so.
segments.zh: 在如此强劲的相对表现之后，往往会出现板块轮动。因此，我们预计未来两个月左右，资金将轮动至传统价值板块。
